economy.label: Real GDP growth
economy.detail: KNBS reported real GDP growth of 4.6% in 2025, compared with 4.7% in 2024.

economy.label: Construction sector
economy.detail: KNBS reported construction returned to growth in 2025 after a contraction in 2024.

economy.label: Agriculture, forestry and fishing
economy.detail: KNBS reported expansion in this sector, which accounts for over one-fifth of the economy.

economy.label: Debt-service pressure
economy.detail: Reuters reported debt servicing consumes about 40% of government revenue, constraining public finance choices.

developments.title: Boma Yangu Mukuru Estate · Mukuru Met Site
developments.date: Boma Yangu project listing · checked 17 October 2026
developments.summary: Boma Yangu lists Mukuru Estate as an ongoing project in South B, Nairobi, and describes the Mukuru Met Site social-housing development near Enterprise Road. Its project page includes photos of housing blocks under development. The listing does not establish completion, handover, occupancy, or affordability outcomes.
developments.watch: Check dated project updates for construction progress, completed and occupied units, handover to eligible households, affordability, resident rehousing, budgets, and audit findings.

developments.title: Affordable housing and slum-upgrading programmes
developments.date: Official department programme information · check for dated project updates
developments.summary: The State Department for Housing and Urban Development lists affordable housing and slum upgrading among its responsibilities. Programme information alone does not confirm results at a specific site.
developments.watch: For Mukuru and other locations, verify dated project plans, site and parcel details, budgets, construction milestones, completed and occupied units, resident rehousing, affordability, and audit findings using project-specific official records.

developments.title: National Infrastructure Fund begins deploying seed capital
developments.summary: Reuters reported the fund began buying domestic government bonds, with a stated aim of improving bank liquidity and mobilising investment in energy, transport, ICT, water and agriculture.
developments.watch: Track actual disbursements, funded projects, private lending, value for money and public liabilities—not only announced targets.

developments.title: New national development framework announced
developments.summary: The Standard reported a proposed national development framework intended to succeed Vision 2030.
developments.watch: Look for published plans, budget allocations, timelines, county-level delivery and independent progress audits.

developments.title: Economic growth and sector performance
developments.summary: KNBS reported 4.6% real GDP growth in 2025, with construction at 6.8% and agriculture at 3.1%.
developments.watch: GDP growth alone does not describe household purchasing power, job quality, inequality or the cost of essentials.

publicOpinion.title: Direction of the country
publicOpinion.summary: A TIFA survey reported 74% of respondents believed Kenya was moving in the wrong direction and 14% said it was moving in the right direction.

publicOpinion.title: Trust in the president
publicOpinion.summary: A TIFA survey reported 29% positive trust and 68% little or no trust in President William Ruto among surveyed respondents.
